items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: But I had met Sid Nathan and Wynon Harris, because I did a big hit for him.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Glover, because I had played out in Cincinatti before this. We went out that way long time ago with Chick (inaudible) King when we played around Cincinatti. But I had met Sid Nathan and Wynon Harris, because I did a big hit for him. 'All She Wanna Do Is Rock.'
You wrote the song or you arranged it?
